questions.text: I _____ studying at 8 o'clock tomorrow.
questions.explanation: For an action in progress at a specific time in the future, we use Future Continuous: will be + V-ing.
questions.explanationAr: لحدث مستمر في وقت محدد في المستقبل، نستخدم المستقبل المستمر: will be + V-ing.

questions.text: This time next week, I _____ traveling.
questions.explanation: We use Future Continuous for a future duration.
questions.explanationAr: نستخدم المستقبل المستمر لفترة زمنية في المستقبل.

questions.text: While you are sleeping, I _____ working.
questions.explanation: For parallel actions in the future, we can use the Future Continuous.
questions.explanationAr: للأحداث المتوازية في المستقبل، يمكننا استخدام المستقبل المستمر.

questions.text: _____ you be using the car tomorrow?
questions.explanation: For polite inquiries about the future, we can use the Future Continuous starting with 'Will'.
questions.explanationAr: للاستفسارات المهذبة حول المستقبل، يمكننا استخدام المستقبل المستمر بدءًا من 'Will'.

questions.text: They _____ meeting the client at noon.
questions.explanation: We use 'will be' + V-ing for assumptions about future actions in progress.
questions.explanationAr: نستخدم 'will be' + V-ing للافتراضات حول أحداث مستقبلية مستمرة.

questions.text: I _____ sleeping at 10 pm tonight.
questions.explanation: The negative form of Future Continuous is 'will not be' or 'won't be' + V-ing.
questions.explanationAr: صيغة النفي في المستقبل المستمر هي 'will not be' أو 'won't be' + V-ing.

questions.text: They _____ coming this weekend.
questions.explanation: The negative form is 'won't be' + V-ing.
questions.explanationAr: صيغة النفي هي 'won't be' + V-ing.

questions.text: _____ you be working the meeting tomorrow?
questions.explanation: Questions in the Future Continuous start with 'Will'.
questions.explanationAr: الأسئلة في المستقبل المستمر تبدأ بـ 'Will'.

questions.text: _____ they be traveling next week?
questions.explanation: Questions start with 'Will' + Subject + be + V-ing.
questions.explanationAr: الأسئلة تبدأ بـ 'Will' + الفاعل + be + V-ing.

questions.text: Will you be watching the match? Yes, I _____.
questions.explanation: The short affirmative answer is 'Yes, I will'.
questions.explanationAr: الإجابة القصيرة بالإثبات هي 'Yes, I will'.

questions.text: Will they be coming tonight? No, they _____.
questions.explanation: The short negative answer is 'No, they won't'.
questions.explanationAr: الإجابة القصيرة بالنفي هي 'No, they won't'.

questions.text: What is the structure of the Future Continuous?
questions.explanation: The structure uses 'will be' followed by the verb with an -ing ending.
questions.explanationAr: تستخدم البنية 'will be' متبوعة بالفعل مع إضافة -ing.

questions.text: She will be _____ a training course next month.
questions.explanation: After 'will be', we use the V-ing form.
questions.explanationAr: بعد 'will be'، نستخدم صيغة V-ing.

questions.text: We will be _____ the team next Monday.
questions.explanation: After 'will be', we use the V-ing form.
questions.explanationAr: بعد 'will be'، نستخدم صيغة V-ing.

questions.text: They will be _____ dinner at a restaurant in the evening.
questions.explanation: After 'will be', we use the V-ing form.
questions.explanationAr: بعد 'will be'، نستخدم صيغة V-ing.

questions.text: I will be flying to Dubai _____.
questions.explanation: 'tomorrow' is a signal word for the future.
questions.explanationAr: 'tomorrow' (غدًا) هي كلمة دالة على المستقبل.

questions.text: _____ time tomorrow, I will be working.
questions.explanation: 'This time tomorrow' is a common signal phrase for the Future Continuous.
questions.explanationAr: 'This time tomorrow' (في مثل هذا الوقت غدًا) هي عبارة دالة شائعة للمستقبل المستمر.

questions.text: I will be studying _____ two hours.
questions.explanation: 'in two hours' indicates a future time when an action will be in progress.
questions.explanationAr: 'in two hours' (خلال ساعتين) تشير إلى وقت في المستقبل حيث سيكون الحدث مستمراً.

questions.text: I won't _____ working this weekend.
questions.explanation: The negative form is 'won't be' + V-ing.
questions.explanationAr: صيغة النفي هي 'won't be' + V-ing.

questions.text: Will she _____ working on Friday?
questions.explanation: The question form is 'Will' + Subject + 'be' + V-ing.
questions.explanationAr: صيغة السؤال هي 'Will' + الفاعل + 'be' + V-ing.

questions.text: 'I will studying at 8 pm.' is a correct sentence.
questions.explanation: It is incorrect. You need 'be' before the V-ing: 'I will be studying at 8 pm.'
questions.explanationAr: إنها خاطئة. تحتاج إلى 'be' قبل V-ing: 'I will be studying at 8 pm.'

questions.text: 'She will be work tomorrow.' is a correct sentence.
questions.explanation: It is incorrect. You must add -ing to the verb: 'She will be working tomorrow.'
questions.explanationAr: إنها خاطئة. يجب إضافة -ing للفعل: 'She will be working tomorrow.'

questions.text: 'Will you be goes to the party?' is a correct question.
questions.explanation: It is incorrect. You must use the V-ing form: 'Will you be going to the party?'
questions.explanationAr: إنها خاطئة. يجب استخدام صيغة V-ing: 'Will you be going to the party?'

questions.text: 'I will be visiting my friend.' is a correct sentence.
questions.explanation: It is correct. It properly uses 'will be' + V-ing.
questions.explanationAr: إنها صحيحة. تستخدم بشكل صحيح 'will be' + V-ing.

questions.text: 'This time next week, I will be traveling.' emphasizes an action in progress in the future.
questions.explanation: It is correct. 'This time next week' points to a specific future moment when the traveling will be happening.
questions.explanationAr: إنها صحيحة. 'This time next week' تشير إلى لحظة مستقبلية محددة حيث سيكون السفر مستمراً.
